decisions.review_required: Determine whether a release authorizes generic elapsed-time observation or a specific agreement, Unyt action target and Holochain DNA. If target bound, require an actually signed and verifier-enforced v3 domain-separated binding; an unsigned JSON wrapper around v2 is invalid.

A signed old lower bound remains historical evidence; rejecting a duplicate consumed Unyt source requires independent native source-chain validation in either case. Do not label repeated oracle signatures double spending.

Specify authenticated deadline, evidence proving deadline passage, refund entitlement, already accepted tranches, outstanding recipient Accept, fees, abandoned agreements, and source-chain transition rules.

Current Rhai checks time on REFUND, not SLASH. A proposed close must use authenticated native execution timing, not the absence of a recent signed time statement. Specify ordering/races at the exact boundary and challenge prioritization.
Clarify permitted slash evidence, oracle DNA scope, key rotations, bond term, reporter reward, slash beneficiary, fee payer, and whether honest time error or unavailability is out-of-scope.

An existing v2 signature cannot be reinterpreted as a signed target commitment. Define how pending deposits/carryover/old accepts resolve without silently changing already parked rules or the Holochain DNA.
